statement: Mining sampling relies on five stats; mining efficiency is the base stat and more of it gives more ore per hour and higher sample rate
Mining speed is probably the most important stat but has few sources
Mining speed caps at 62 per minute; once there ignore other sources
Main mining speed sources are mining level and boost foods
Multi-ore drop chance gives more ore per pickaxe swing
Multi-ore chance caps at 300 percent
Maximizing multi-ore chance is one of the easiest ways to increase sampling early and is mandatory late for the best samples
Printer sample rate is checked in construction skill info and caps at 90
Check his printer sampling guide for ways to get more printer sample rate
AFK gain rate is the best stat point for point and multiplies the benefit of all other mining stats
Use two gear sets: an efficiency set and an HP snapshot set using Hardy Diggy bubble
Use three pieces of magma/dreadlo gear for efficiency since strength and all stats convert to mining efficiency
Without dreadlo gear use Viking cap and dirty coal miner baggy soot pants for mining efficiency
Testing showed efficiency dropped using the 5 percent mining efficiency pieces compared to base strength from gear
Funny hat with skill efficiency gave more efficiency than Viking cap; difference small once you have magma gear
Divine scarf pendant is best in slot for strength multiplied by talents and 25 percent all AFK gain rate
Persephone's bouquet is second best pendant if you lack the divine scarf
Use serrated Rex rings giving 8 percent skill efficiency each
Keep three sets of serrated Rex rings with strength agility and wisdom; use strength version for mining
Snoozy count gives 10 percent all AFK gain rate
Idle Skiller trophy is best in slot but king of foods trophy needed later for the HP set
Blunder Hills trophy gives 3 percent all skill AFK gain rate if no Idle Skiller trophy
Giant star flower wings best at 13 percent AFK gain; angel wings 11 and other flower 9 are alternatives
Use two keychains with the most AFK gain rate as primary stat
Put highest AFK gain keychain in top slot because of lab chip doubling
Get the best pickaxe since it raises mining speed power and gives lots of strength
Roughly nine times the shown strength applies to the character so a pickaxe with 65 strength gives almost 600
All other tools should be versions with the most strength
Efficiency food setup: golden grilled cheese nomwiches for strength; golden peanut for mining efficiency; three boost foods to reach 62 mining speed
You may not need all boost foods if mining level gives enough speed to hit cap
Use only a small amount of event foods and unequip them after sampling so they are not used up since they can't be replenished until an event
Secondary gear set maximizes HP for a snapshot
Snapshot set uses best strength keychains (4 percent each; top slot irrelevant with lab chip) plus giant violet for percent all stats and king of food trophy
Snapshot set uses opal rings for percent strength and all stats; dreadlo boots; royal turbine helmet to multiply golden food
Golden jam multiplies max HP and golden grilled cheese nomwiches are used in the HP set
Switch top four food slots to health potions for the snapshot
Snapshot gear pushed HP to about 7.5 million at this point in the guide
Four main talents on tab one: brood efficiency; fist of rage; health booster; idle skilling
Fist of Rage raises max strength which raises max HP and mining efficiency
Idle Skilling increases overall AFK gain rate
Big pick is an active skill that must be on the attack bar and increases ore from mining
Copper collector gives mining efficiency based on ore stored in chest so cap it out as soon as possible
Motherload miner adds multi-ore chance; max it until you reach the 300 percent cap
Tool proficiency multiplies pickaxe power per power of 10 mining levels so level 100 gives a spike
Stress tested garb for equipment strength; at least one point in firmly grasp for 15 base strength; absolute unit and firmly grasp are equal value
Max strength in numbers for HP from strength; health overdrive multiplies max HP
Hungry for gold boosts golden food by 40 percent or more and is not super important
Tab three priorities: strengths and more; fist of rage; shieldiest statue for statue mining power; fistful of obols for obol strength
Super samples gives six to seven percent printer sampling if you lack sample rate
Tab four: overblown testosterone for strength and talent levels; skill strengthen for skill efficiency and strength
Symbols of Beyond and family guide are helpful but optional
In the family tab total strength and total HP bonuses are very useful and weapon power is not
Always keep orb of remembrance equipped for more printer output based on power of 10 kills
Star talents: Will the eldest for stats; Tick Tock for AFK gain; toilet paper postage stamp for stamp efficiency
Toilet paper postage stamp scales badly after bonus 1.5 so extra points are less helpful
Tab two: frothy malk for food and potion bonuses; super source for base efficiency; action frenzy for skilling speed
Printer sampling talent adds up to 18 with 100 points
Uber charged health gives base HP; stat overload gives 300 unmultiplied base strength and is low priority
Dwarfo beardis star sign gives 5 percent mining efficiency and 20 percent multi-ore chance
Mount etorist star sign gives 15 percent all food effect
Big comatose gives 2 percent skill AFK gain but he gets better gains from the other two
Use comatose major for 4 percent skill AFK gain as third star sign
Mining statue gives mining power which translates directly to efficiency
Feasty statue multiplies potions and food bonuses giving more HP and efficiency from golden peanuts
Health statue gives a small amount of base HP but statues add up
Unlock golden statues so statue bonuses apply to all characters
Want base HP stamps (heart; vitality; black heart) and strength stamps (fist; violence; maxo slapo)
Stat graft stamp is very expensive and hard to level but gives more base stats
Pickaxe stamp gives base mining efficiency; under-leveled notice means it scales slower but still helps
Twin ore stamp for multi-ore chance; cool diggy tool stamp for lots of base mining efficiency
Multi-tool stamp gives base all skill efficiency and is expensive to level but high value
Companion sandy pot gives 15 percent base all stats
Companion board mean gives 5 percent AFK gain and multi gives 5 percent all skill efficiency
Cheapy companion keeps all big bubbles counted as equipped
Ripped slug companion gives 25 free talent levels
King dude is quality of life; gives about 3.5 percent more AFK gain but you can sample at max rate without it
King dude becomes less useful in endgame since you sample less often
Level reuten bubble as often as possible; one strength per level becomes about five with multipliers
Warriors rule gives 2.5x to orange bubbles on warrior-based class like divine knight
Hardy Diggy gives mining efficiency per power of 10 max HP so max HP matters
Wyoming blood raises max multi-ore chance from 100 to 300 percent; mandatory; level 184-185 to get 300 from it
Wyoming blood need not reach 185 if star signs and stamps bring stat sheet total to 300 percent
Really smart bubble mostly helps fishing; only helps mining sampling by leveling faster
Level strong tools to multiply pickaxe skilling power; expensive early due to platinum ore
Malt orange multiplies first and third bubbles for strength and efficiency; worth leveling but can be expensive
Slabby orfish gives about 28 mining power from 1400 slab items unmultiplied; don't invest early
Slabby strengthen gives strength from slab items; not super important but some gain
Prowessary lowers efficiency needed for next multi-ore tier; caps at 2x total with leaks data menu post office and alchemy so stop leveling at two
Stamp bubble raises max level of toilet paper postage stamp
Sample it bubble increases overall sample size
Big P bubble is mandatory and multiplies minor link bonuses of equipped divinities; equip on every character especially goat god
Void vial is mandatory for mining efficiency
Every vial should be level 13 because of the rift vial mastery bonus
Snow slurry gives more printer sample size
Pearl seltzer gives percent all stats; expensive but worth it
Mining box gives mining efficiency prowess and AFK gain; food box for boost food and food effect; health box for max HP
Second tab: utility crate for printer sample size; gaming crate for strength; myriad crate for all base stats and efficiency
Myriad crate needs a huge amount of post office boxes so may not be worth it early
Use circle opals on the character for mining power and strength; square and hexagon opals also mining
Dilapidated slush opals beat mining hexagon; sparkle opal either new molten (5 percent AFK gain) or mining sparkle
Dilapidated slush opal gives 4 percent versus 2 percent so use it if you can get enough
He personally gets better gains from AFK gain rate opals than efficiency opals
Royal sampler increases printer sample size but reduces all exp; don't over level since other sources exist
Equip dessert rush for AFK gain and skilled dimwit for skill efficiency; avoid balance of proficiency and rucksack
Level helium atom as much as possible; it gives more copper collector tiers and a huge efficiency bonus
Primary lab jewels: sapphire navette for all stats and strength; certified book stamp doubles stamp bonuses; my first chemistry set doubles vial bonuses
Black diamond rhinestone gives 24 percent bonus to dinner menu items and is basically mandatory
Console setup: double top-left and bottom-right cards; 15 percent skill AFK chip; four orange chips doubling star sign trophy keychain and pendant
Best keychain must be in upper keychain slot for the chip
Four dinner meals: corn 2 percent and rice ball 3 percent and whipped cocoa 4 percent skill efficiency per level; leek for prowess
Leek prowess effect caps at 2x so may not need high level
Shiny pet passives for all meals; base efficiency for all skills; and base stats
Base stat shiny pets give about 10 base stat at 2 percent per shiny level
Skill mastery uses total level across all 10 characters; above 500 gives 5 percent all skill efficiency per skill
At 750 total skill level you get 1 percent printer output per skill and all mining cards become passive
With mining mastery all mining-related cards are passive so no particular card set is needed though optimization remains
All skills above 750 give 75 percent more efficiency and 15 percent more printer output
Vial mastery gives 2 percent multiplier to all vials per vial at level 13; 38 vials gives 76 percent
Ruby cards unlock another card tier and more card levels; a grind but increases mining gains with passive cards
Infinite star sign makes all star signs active; requires leveling shiny pets
Star sign doubling applies only to the selected star signs so still select the right ones
Frost relic gives 30 percent efficiency per tier (90 at eldritch) for skills in worlds 1-3
Chilled yarn multiplies sigil and alchemy bonuses and is tripled at eldritch for six times sigil bonus
Sigils: emoji veggie for golden foods; big muscle for strength; dream catcher 3 percent skill AFK gain (18 percent with multiplier)
Fury relic gives more max talent book levels
Socrates relic gives 10 all stats per tier (30 total) giving 30 more strength
Gold relic multiplies printer output for every day you don't resample for all characters; hidden from stats
Use gold relic bonus wisely and be selective about when you sample
Put snake god on one to two characters for 30 percent AFK gain and goat god on other eight to nine
Goat god gives about 3 to 4 percent AFK gain to all characters
Big P on every character gives about extra 30 percent AFK gain from goat god
Hareep multiplies 3D printer resources by 3 and multiplies with lab bonus for 6x printing
With Dute active all characters get lab bonus so 6x printing on all characters
There are three card sets depending on bonuses unlocked
Best set with passive mining cards: chaotic troll (60 percent skill efficiency); choco box (boost food effect); blighted cheese or trimmer worm; stilted seeker; octadar
Money card and amrock card for skill AFK gain in remaining slots
Keep top-left and bottom-right cards in the same spot on all sets so card doubler works
Without passive mining cards use a set with efficiency and mining speed cards
HP snapshot cards: love you light and mammoth for base HP; boost food effect; percent all stats cards; goblin for percent HP
He has about 3.8 trillion efficiency with max speed and multi-ore and a sample of about 543 million
To snapshot go to world one town; equip HP trinkets rings king of foods giant violet royal turbine boots and swap foods
Then open cards and switch to HP card set and food-effect card set
Make sure shrine is placed in the mining map or in world five town for all-maps effect so it helps HP
With HP set he reached 13.7 million HP then returns to mining map efficiency drops to billions until swapping back
Open alchemy tab first to snapshot current HP then swap cards and efficiency gear back
Re-equip rings keychains wings trophy helmet boots and food and restore speed and efficiency after snapshot
Snapshot raised efficiency over 4 trillion and sample to about 500 million
Snapshot gave roughly 10 million more ore which is a good deal
Repeat the snapshot swap process again to switch back to HP set for the next map
Only need to snapshot once per map; less tedious for mining than chopping
Open alchemy first to snapshot then swap everything back and sample
Check efficiency is the same then use big pick to sample gold ore and iron; wait for big pick to be ready
Copper ore sample rose from 240 million to over 500 million; now waiting on gold relic multiplier
